description: Defines the class 'slot_point_extended' which extends 'slot_point' with additional functionality related to HyperSFN, SFN, and slot indexing for 5G NR systems, including constructors, comparison operators, arithmetic operators, and formatting support.

classes.name: slot_point_extended
classes.description: Represents a slot point with extended information including HyperSFN, SFN, and slot index, with comparison and arithmetic operations.

methods.name: nof_slots_in_all_hyper_sfns
methods.description: Returns the total number of slots across all HyperSFNs.

methods.name: without_hyper_sfn
methods.description: Converts 'slot_point_extended' to 'slot_point' by removing HyperSFN component.

methods.name: operator<=
methods.description: Checks if one 'slot_point_extended' is less than or equal to another.

methods.name: operator>=
methods.description: Checks if one 'slot_point_extended' is greater than or equal to another.

methods.name: operator>
methods.description: Checks if one 'slot_point_extended' is greater than another.

methods.name: operator-
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two 'slot_point_extended' objects.

methods.name: is_in_interval
methods.description: Checks if the slot point is within a specified interval.
